_program_name_note: Working name for the member community and resource hub (D-025). It appears in the wordmark, titles and copy; renaming it is a find-and-replace across content/ plus this field.
_show_draft_notice_note: Renders a discreet 'Draft' ribbon on any page whose front matter says status: draft. Set false to hide it for a clean screen-share, but the copy is still a working draft pending compliance review -- the flag changes the ribbon, not the facts. Set each page's status to 'final' as copy is approved.
_path_prefix_note: Where the microsite is mounted. PLAN.md decision #6: main domain at /succession vs a subdomain. If it becomes a subdomain root, set this to "". Build with --local to preview at a server root.
_base_url_note: PLACEHOLDER - confirm the real domain and whether the microsite lives at /succession or on a subdomain (PLAN.md decision #6).
_local_tools_note: INTERNAL ONLY. Convenience links included in --local preview builds so working tools sit one click from the site. They are NEVER emitted by a production build and never appear in the sitemap -- the dashboard contains the proprietary scored prospect list (named firms, phone numbers, readiness scores). Guarded by a test.
